I have farmed in Tabora since I was a boy, and I know this land well. For my 0.34-hectare plot, I will spread manure from my cattle because I do not have money for chemical fertilizer, and I do not trust those bagged fertilizers anyway. I will plant the seed I saved from my own harvest last season, and my family will do all the work by hand since we cannot afford to hire anyone or buy pesticides. The rains will come when God sends them, so I will not irrigate.
